name: zdeclient_dispatch_feature_event_templates
description: zDEClient::DispatchFeatureEventTemplates walks stored feature entries and dispatches crater or quicksand event-template snapshots to optional callbacks.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zDEClient feature serialization/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457c50 validates iteration from g_zDEClient_FeatureListBegin to g_zDEClient_FeatureListEnd in 0x34-byte records, copying each entry to a local 0x34-byte snapshot, dispatching featureType 1 to the ECX crater callback when non-null, dispatching featureType 3 to the EDX quicksand callback when non-null, passing the local eventData address in ECX, ignoring other feature types, and returning void.

The native zDEClient dispatch smoke verifies crater and quicksand callback counts, ignored feature types, null-handler skipping, empty-list behavior, and that callback mutations affect only the local copied entry rather than the stored feature list.
